name: Whole original open costume crown
limits: Original complete costume crown with an open circular head band and eight repeated raised scalloped points, rolled bottom ridges and actual inner wall/thickness. One connected annular material shell, open top and bottom. Published BOSS whole crown stimulus personally inspected; original photographer/maker unverified. Own approximate dimensions and simplified hidden underside; not a historical/manufacturer reconstruction. No copied photograph/texture/logo, no old chess component, no jewels/colour/point-count variants counted. Plain original metallic material and geometry only. Static prop; no wearable fit, material assay, safety, rig, collider or Unity certification. Actual unlabelled128px reviewers recognition is conservative judgment, not audience study. Reduced curvature and undenoised grain disclosed; no universal imported-shading equivalence.

recognition_gate.method: Reviewers personally reviewed actual unlabelled whole model render, conservative judgment not audience test
